name: Augustus
title: First Roman emperor
note: Caesar's adopted son. Founded the Empire. Pax Romana

name: Livia
title: Roman empress
note: Wife of Augustus; the most influential woman in Rome

name: Tiberius
title: 2nd Roman emperor
note: Augustus' adopted son. Retired to Capri

name: Caligula
title: 3rd Roman emperor
note: Byword for tyranny. Assassinated by the Praetorian Guard

name: Claudius
title: 4th Roman emperor
note: Conquered Britannia

name: Nero
title: 5th Roman emperor
note: Great Fire of Rome. Last of the Julio-Claudian dynasty

name: Vespasian
title: 9th Roman emperor
note: Founded the Flavian dynasty. Began the Colosseum

name: Titus
title: 10th Roman emperor
note: Vesuvius eruption; Colosseum completed

name: Domitian
title: 11th Roman emperor
note: Last of the Flavians. Assassinated

name: Nerva
title: 12th Roman emperor
note: First of the Five Good Emperors. Established adoption succession

name: Trajan
title: 13th Roman emperor
note: Five Good Emperors. Empire at its greatest extent

name: Hadrian
title: 14th Roman emperor
note: Five Good Emperors. Hadrian's Wall. Rebuilt the Pantheon

name: Antoninus Pius
title: 15th Roman emperor
note: Five Good Emperors. Adopted Marcus Aurelius

name: Marcus Aurelius
title: 16th Roman emperor
note: Five Good Emperors. "Philosopher Emperor", author of Meditations

name: Commodus
title: 17th Roman emperor
note: Tyranny. Last of the Nerva-Antonine dynasty

name: Septimius Severus
title: 21st Roman emperor
note: Founded the Severan dynasty

name: Caracalla
title: 22nd Roman emperor
note: Edict of Caracalla (granted citizenship)

name: Aurelian
title: 40th Roman emperor
note: Soldier emperor. Reunified the Empire

name: Diocletian
title: 51st Roman emperor
note: Tetrarchy. Established autocracy

name: Theodosius I
title: 66th Roman emperor
note: Made Christianity the state religion. Divided the Empire

name: Romulus Augustulus
title: Last Western Roman emperor
note: Fall of the Western Roman Empire (476)
